profile.headline: Working in Great Seattle Area
profile.summary:
I’m a backend software engineer with many years of experience building Java-based systems and services.
 
Most recently, I worked at Five9 on the Numbers platform and STIR/SHAKEN services, using Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, GCP, and CockroachDB. Before Five9, I spent nearly seven years at T-Mobile building microservices for the Customer Care organization.
 
I enjoy backend engineering, especially system design, distributed systems, performance, and solving production problems. I also enjoy learning new tools and finding practical ways to use AI, including Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, in day-to-day software development.
 
I’m always interested in working with good people on challenging engineering problems and continuing to learn along the way.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Team Lead)
positions.description:
Design and develop cloud-based SaaS solutions for Five9’s contact center platform, focusing on number management services, STIR/SHAKEN provisioning, and enterprise communication infrastructure.

Work on scalable backend services and full-stack features using Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, GCP, CockroachDB, BigQuery, React, and TypeScript. Collaborate across engineering teams to deliver reliable, production-quality solutions that support customer-facing communication services.

Key contributions:

• Led the STIR/SHAKEN provisioning project, delivering the integration interface between Five9 and TransUnion to support secure caller identity verification and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Developed and enhanced Numbers Service capabilities, implementing functional improvements and backend services supporting contact center communication workflows.

• Improved functional test execution performance by approximately 100% by redesigning the test execution approach using process forking and parallel test execution with multiple worker processes.

• Leveraged modern AI-assisted development tools, including Claude and GitHub Copilot, to improve engineering productivity, accelerate development workflows, and enhance code quality.

• Built and maintained cloud-native applications using Kubernetes-based deployment environments and GCP services, including BigQuery for data processing and analytics.

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, design solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and deliver enterprise-scale software enhancements.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed large-scale customer care solutions supporting frontline operations through highly available, scalable microservices. Built and enhanced critical customer-facing capabilities, including AutoPay, customer notes/memo services, feedback tools, and other workflow solutions used by customer care representatives.

Key contributions:
• Led the design and development of a virtual training platform that enabled customer care representatives to practice workflows in a simulated environment before handling real customer interactions. The solution reduced representative error rates by approximately 90% and improved overall operational productivity.

• Developed and maintained enterprise microservices using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, databases, and distributed system technologies to support customer care applications.

• Collaborated with multiple engineering teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable software solutions across complex customer service platforms.

• Participated in the modernization of legacy systems by migrating functionality toward scalable microservice-based architectures.

• Improved system reliability and engineering efficiency through automation, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.

Delivered customer-focused software solutions by combining strong backend engineering skills, system design experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

positions.title: Sr. Java Engineer
positions.description:
This Platform as a Service (PAAS) is meticulously crafted to meet the demands of the next generation, boasting high performance and multi-thread capabilities to effortlessly manage the anticipated surge in IoT device reporting.

At the core of our project lies a Microservices architecture, enhanced with queue messaging for seamless communication between services. These components facilitate seamless communication between services and handle external request/response interactions with finesse.

Our relentless focus on scalability, reliability, security, and performance drives our continuous evolution of core components. We continuously refine database and cache utilities to meet and exceed performance expectations, ensuring optimal functionality even under the most demanding circumstances.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
ICT Project (Integrated Contract Tool)
An enterprise level-contracting tool allows sales person to enter the network services contract and automate the contract approval process. The system consolidates three legacy-contracting tools into one single system. 
	Designed and implemented for fault-tolerance and high performance interface, utilizing distributed transaction controls, persisted JMS messages with MQ-Series.
	Solely responsible for analyzed XML object model and created interface program to parse and validate XML document by using SAX and DOM API in JAXP.
	Took lead of application designing, modeling and implementing J2EE platform technology, using JSP as front end and Oracle as backend database. 
	Solely responsible for production support to solve customer issues. 
	Responsible to coordinate with outsourcing development team (India) with US team.
